faqs.q: How can I check my Working with Children Check status?
faqs.a: You can check your status by adding your WWCC to the Service NSW app or by completing the Office of the Children's Guardian (OCG) online form. When using the OCG form, select 'Verifying my own check' as the reason for verification.

faqs.q: Who can verify a Working with Children Check?
faqs.a: Verification is available for an organization, business or sole trader with employees, or for a parent, guardian, or carer.

faqs.q: What information do I need to check my WWCC status?
faqs.a: You will need your name, date of birth, and either your WWCC number or application (APP) number.
